name: Cookies - Chicago
how_menu_is_reached: /shop/ with category filters. /locations/cookies-chicago-clinton/ is the branch page.
why_it_fails: Resolution failed with TRANSPORT_ERROR (ConnectError) on the chain directory lead cookies.co/stores/. The brand domain cookieschicago.co loads in the probe.
fix_idea: Map the chain directory domain to the brand domain, or resolve from the registry address. Then identify the /shop/ menu platform.
method: Manual browser check (installed Chrome probe and Google/Bing search); pipeline data read-only from terpscout.db; sample run with scripts/sample_stores.py --pages 1.
